data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided scientific-educational differentiable-simulation figure into a corrected SCI-journal-style time-unrolled diagram, preserving the existing pale blue panel style, repeated panels (k=0, k=1, k, k=T-1), large readable labels, clean black forward arrows, red backward-gradient arrows, and the right-side legend. Keep the same core modules and overall composition: x_k,c_k, S_phi, D_obs,k as the grayscale depth thumbnail, Pi_theta with split heads Pi_f and Pi_c, u_k, c*_{k+1}, EMA, f_dyn, L_sens / L_teach, L_flight. Do not add Q_t, M_t, or a separate R renderer.

Primary corrections to implement clearly in every time-step panel:
1) Forward camera update: c_k and c*_{k+1} both feed into EMA; EMA outputs c_{k+1}. Draw a clear black arrow from c_k into EMA and a clear black arrow from Pi_c -> c*_{k+1} into EMA. Label the EMA output as c_{k+1}.
2) Forward UAV dynamics update: u_k and x_k feed into f_dyn; f_dyn outputs x_{k+1}. Draw a clear black arrow from Pi_f -> u_k into f_dyn and a clear black arrow from x_k into f_dyn. Label the f_dyn output as x_{k+1}.
3) Next-state merge: the next state circle must visibly combine the two separate outputs x_{k+1} from f_dyn and c_{k+1} from EMA. Draw two clean black arrows that merge into the next state circle labeled x_{k+1}, c_{k+1}. Avoid ambiguous bus lines or arrows that make EMA look like it feeds f_dyn.
4) Backward gradients: keep the black forward graph unchanged except for the corrections above. Red gradient from L_flight should go back through f_dyn, u_k, Pi_f / Pi_theta, D_obs,k, and S_phi. Do NOT draw a solid red gradient from L_flight into Pi_c or EMA. Red gradient from L_sens / L_teach should go back to S_phi and to the camera register c_k. Label this camera-register gradient dL/dc_k. If a camera-side gradient availability must be indicated, use a faint dashed red arrow labeled available / frozen near Pi_c, not a solid update arrow.
5) Perception-to-policy path: keep S_phi -> D_obs,k -> Pi_theta visually dominant and clear. D_obs,k must be represented as the grayscale depth thumbnail. A black arrow from the depth thumbnail must enter Pi_theta.
6) Policy relation: Pi_theta is a split policy with two heads: Pi_f -> u_k and Pi_c -> c*_{k+1}. Pi_f and Pi_c are parallel heads, not sequential policies. Do not draw arrows from Pi_f to Pi_c or Pi_c to Pi_f.

Style constraints: elegant, smooth, minimal crossings, large readable labels, close to the reference style. Preserve the right-side legend. Ensure the black forward graph is crisp and the corrected arrows are unambiguous. Keep the figure on a 1536x512 canvas, same overall layout and proportions.
